card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle or ending piece of a longer word that has been split, such as 'els' after Tow, 'c' in mycotic or mycophenolic, and 'lo' in canagliflozin. It also fires on a few unrelated linking words.

modes.label: Split common words
modes.description: Ending piece of an everyday word split after its start, such as towels.
modes.example: Tow<<els>> should not be shared nor clothing exchanged.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Middle piece of drug or disease words such as mycotic, mycophenolic, canagliflozin or levodopa.
